changelog.1.0.24: Fixed parameter_method for get_values, get_spreadsheet, and batch_get_values services - changed from query_params to url_pattern to properly handle path parameters
changelog.2.0.0: MAJOR UPDATE: Added comprehensive parameter lookup functionality for enhanced user experience. Spreadsheet IDs now support dropdown selection with real-time data from Google Drive API. Range parameters include common range patterns for quick selection. Sheet IDs provide standard options. This eliminates manual ID entry and significantly improves usability.
changelog.2.1.0: Added missing list_spreadsheets service to support parameter lookups for spreadsheet ID selection. This service queries Google Drive API to list available spreadsheets.
changelog.2.2.0: Simplified list_spreadsheets service to use full URL in endpoint_template, leveraging existing URL handling that skips base_url prepending for absolute URLs.
